ordering: SDK edges are grouped by owner for comparison. The dependency-first local order inserts SDK immediately before its first direct owner; each retained edge has target before owner, and every node occurs exactly once. Exact Go topological order is not claimed.
counterPolicy: Bundle construction uses a separate SDK budget. SDK injection performs no source reads and does not add embedded SDK sources to local source counters, matching the owning Go loader. The full load/SDK/visibility path commits caller local counts only after success.
